items.name: tokens
items.title: Tokens
items.description: shadcn's colour and radius tokens, light and dark, for Tailwind projects without shadcn.

items.name: theme-init
items.title: Theme init
items.description: Sets the theme's class on <html> before the app starts, so a dark theme doesn't flash light.

items.name: theme-provider
items.title: Theme provider
items.description: Light, dark or the system's theme as a class on <html>, saved, and following the OS as it changes.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme toggle
items.description: A button showing the theme on screen, with a menu to choose Light, Dark or System.
